items: Hijacked GitHub accounts plant a secret stealer

slides.title: Hijacked GitHub accounts plant a secret stealer
slides.body: Stolen logins for 4,837 real GitHub accounts were used to slip a credential stealer into thousands of repositories. It grabs API keys, cloud and npm credentials, then often deletes its tracks.
slides.box: Check repos for wfx-docs branches and gaps in workflow run numbers. If in doubt, rotate your secrets and turn on 2FA.

slides.title: Microsoft 365 goes down for most of a day
slides.body: On 12 November, Outlook, Teams, Copilot and more failed around the world for about 18 hours. Microsoft says it wasn't an attack.
slides.box: Have a way to reach your team and customers that doesn't rely on the same provider, and bookmark Microsoft's status page.

slides.title: Outlook and Chrome both had exploited flaws
slides.body: A crafted file could make Outlook leak login details, and Chrome had its eighth exploited zero-day of 2026. Both are fixed.
slides.box: Make sure Office has updated, not just Windows, then restart Chrome so its update applies.

slides.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2
slides.body: A new top-end model with a 1M-token context window, available through the Claude API and the big cloud platforms.
slides.box: If you build on Claude, test before switching: some tool and data-retention changes could break existing setups.

slides.title: What I'd do this week
items: Search GitHub repos for wfx-docs branches and rotate any exposed secrets
Turn on 2FA for every account that can push to your repos
Check Office (not just Windows) has updated, and relaunch Chrome
Update Node.js to the latest patch release
Plan how you'd reach customers if your email went down tomorrow

slides.body: The full write-up, with sources, is on my blog. New roundup every Sunday.
